subject: Post-call: Eval artifacts, model recommendations, and AB rollout checklist
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Novak <alex@brightcart.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap — model recommendations + artifacts

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the immediate artifacts we discussed so your team can validate model fit and pick the right rollout path.

Key takeaways from call:
- Primary objective: improve on-site search relevance and conversions on category landing pages without increasing tail latency.
- Success metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, cart add rate; guardrails: p95 latency and model hallucination rate.
- Data: you confirmed anonymized click logs and query samples are available — Marcus and I will coordinate the sample export.

Recommended candidate models to validate (order = preference for rerank stage):
1) redwood/rerank-v2-8bit (good MRR gains, quantization-friendly)
2) open-rerank-7b-mrr (lighter, lower latency, still strong NDCG)
3) redwood/ts-rerank-quant (experimental — consider if you want extra recall)

Attached for your review: prompt_set_v1.csv (sample prompts and templating rules), ndcg_mrr_summary.pdf (initial offline eval highlights), rerank_sample_prompts.json (examples used in the tests).

Offline eval snapshot (attached ndcg_mrr_summary.pdf):
- Baseline: NDCG@10 = 0.412, MRR = 0.221
- redwood/rerank-v2-8bit: NDCG@10 = 0.454 (+0.042), MRR = 0.256 (+0.035)
- open-rerank-7b-mrr: NDCG@10 = 0.441 (+0.029), MRR = 0.243 (+0.022)
Notes: numbers are on your 50k query sample, anonymized click labels (train/test split 80/20). We flagged a small cluster of long-tail queries where the reranker introduced a 1–2% repro difference; see section 3 of the PDF for examples.

Proposed AB/canary plan (high level):
- Canary: 5% traffic for 72 hours (sensible for initial validation)
- Metrics to monitor: NDCG@10 (offline/backtest), online click-through rate (CTR), cart add rate, p95 latency (target <200ms), error rate.
- Rollback triggers: drop in NDCG@10 > 1.5 points relative to baseline OR drop in MRR > 0.02 OR online CTR/cart-add drop > 5% vs baseline for 12+ hours.

Immediate asks for BrightCart:
- Confirm you can deliver the 50k anonymized sample (or confirm we can pull it from the index by EOD Friday).
- Agree to the 5% canary start window (proposed week of 2027-06-20).
- Let us know if you need the eval harness or additional instrumentation (we can provide a runner and prebuilt dashboards).

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus to share inference harness instructions and the lightweight canary deployment recipe.
- Stephanie to share SOW template and mutual action plan.
- I’ll put together an action checklist and a short A/B readout template we’ll use during the canary.

Attachments: prompt_set_v1.csv (CSV), ndcg_mrr_summary.pdf (PDF), rerank_sample_prompts.json (JSON)

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Novak <alex@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Post-call recap — model recommendations + artifacts

Adding a few technical notes from the runtime side to avoid surprises during the canary.

1) Quantization/latency: redwood/rerank-v2-8bit gave us a ~30% p95 reduction in our internal runs. That said, please validate KV cache behavior for your session lengths — some queries with long product lists can increase decode tokens.

2) Batch sizing: start with dynamic batching capped at 16 for the canary. For synthetic stress, we should validate at batch=32 to see tail effects.

3) Instrumentation: ensure we send the candidate set size and reranker score per hit to the logs (we rely on these for the NDCG and MRR slice calculations). If you need, use our harness in the repo link (git.redwood.ai/brightcart/rerank-harness) — I’ve attached a short guide: inference_harness_instructions.md.

4) Data retention/security: since BrightCart requested S3 exports for the offline eval, ensure the bucket is encrypted and we use expiring signed URLs for transfers. We’ll help with encryption headers if needed.

Attachment: inference_harness_instructions.md (MD)

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Novak <alex@brightcart.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Li <jordan.li@brightcart.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — model recommendations + artifacts

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear checklist. A few quick items from our side:

- We can get you a 50k anonymized sample by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-16). I’ll have Jordan drop the S3 link into the shared Drive.
- Can you provide an anonymized example of the offline test set you used to generate the attached ndcg_mrr_summary? That will help our data team sanity-check label alignment.
- For the canary, we’d like a short spike test (10 minutes at 3x peak) before the 5% rollout to sanity-check autoscaling. Can your team run that or provide a reproducible script?
- Proposed go-live/canary week: we’re good for 2027-06-20 but need confirmation by Friday so our infra team can block the window.

If the NDCG/MRR lift is consistent on our sample, we’ll proceed. Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
Alex Novak
Head of Search & Personalization, BrightCart
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Novak <alex@brightcart.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-15T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — model recommendations + artifacts

Thanks Alex — that timeline works. Quick sales ops checklist and owners so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) Procurement/SOW: Stephanie to send SOW + pricing options for Dedicated canary usage by EOD Thursday. (owner: Stephanie)
2) Data transfer: BrightCart to place anonymized sample in shared Drive / S3 (owner: Alex / Jordan).
3) Eval harness + spike test: Marcus to run/provide script; Redwood to run spike on our infra and share results. (owner: Marcus)
4) Canary schedule: propose start 2027-06-20 09:00 PT for 72 hours at 5% traffic, with nightly check-ins. Rachel to coordinate calendar invites. (owner: Rachel)
5) A/B readout: short retrospective document + dashboard snapshot after 72 hours — if metrics meet thresholds, we’ll discuss ramp plan. (owner: Rachel / Marcus)

I’ll attach a mutual_action_plan.xlsx with milestones — Rachel, I’ll need you to confirm the SOW tier (canary vs reserved) during our Friday sync. Alex, can you confirm infra availability for the 3x spike on the morning of 2027-06-19?

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
